home.title: Organisational assessment
home.body: To answer the questionnaire, open the link your project sent you.

entry.title: Start your assessment
entry.default_welcome: Project {project}. Enter your organisation's name and an email address: we create your file and send you your personal link.
entry.name: Organisation name
entry.email_hint: Your personal link will be sent to this address. It is the only way to recover it.
entry.consent: I have read how our data is used for this assessment.
entry.created_body: Keep this link: it lets you resume your assessment at any time. We also sent it to you by email; if you do not see it, look in your junk folder (spam).
entry.exists_body: A file already exists for this address in this project. We just sent a new link to that address so you can resume.

link.label: Your personal link
link.warning: Anyone with this link can see and change your assessment. Do not share it.
link.note_personal: This link gives access to your organisation's assessment. Anyone who has it can fill it in and edit it: share it with the colleagues involved, not outside your organisation.
link.note_public: Share this link with the project's organisations. Anyone who opens it can start an assessment; they then receive their own personal link by email.

osc.home_intro: The assessment has 9 sections. Fill them in any order, in one or several sittings: each answer is saved as soon as you give it.
osc.submit_hint: The send button appears once all 9 sections are complete.
osc.submit_confirm: Send your assessment? You can still change your answers until your coach closes the session.
osc.guide_generic:
N/A: the practice does not apply to your organisation.
1: the practice is not in place.
2: the practice is partially or informally in place.
3: the practice is documented and fully operational.
osc.support_question: Would you like support from the organisation to put this in place?
osc.locked_banner: Your coach has closed the session: answers can no longer be changed.
osc.resend: Get a new link by email
osc.resent: A new link has just been sent to the address on file. Check your inbox, and your junk folder (spam) too.
osc.deepen_question: Would you like to go deeper on this section?
osc.deepen_hint: If yes, your coach will come back to this section with you in more detail.
osc.data_hint: This information completes the assessment: it is not scored.
osc.plan_intro: This plan is set by your coach from the support session. You can view it here; only your coach can change it.
osc.plan_empty: Your individual support plan has not been defined yet. It will be set with your coach during the support session: feel free to get in touch with them.

report.title: {name} report
report.intro: Here is a summary of your answers, section by section. Practices to strengthen come first.

errors.locked: The session is closed: changes are not possible.
errors.incomplete: All sections must be complete before sending.

errors.no_framework: No question bank loaded. Run the seed script.
errors.last_admin: At least one administrator must remain.
errors.link_failed: This sign-in link is no longer valid (it works once and lasts one hour). Request a new one.
errors.no_account: No account is linked to this address.
errors.invalid_profile: Check the details entered (first and last name are required).
errors.invalid_section: Enter a name and at least one question.
errors.last_owner_project: The project must keep at least one owner: give the owner role to someone else first.
errors.invalid_entry_profile: Choose the country, the type of structure and the size of your organisation.
errors.airtable_401: Airtable rejects the token (error 401, "Authentication required"). It is invalid, expired or revoked, or was pasted with extra characters. Create a new personal access token at airtable.com/create/tokens, copy it in full (it starts with "pat") and paste it into the "Airtable access token" field.
errors.airtable_403: Airtable recognises the token, but it has no access to this base, or the table does not exist yet (error 403). At airtable.com/create/tokens, add the base under "Access" with the data.records:read and data.records:write scopes; then click "Create the table" if it does not exist.
errors.airtable_404: Base or table not found (error 404). Check the base ID (it starts with "app") and the exact table name, or click "Create the table".
errors.airtable_422: Airtable rejects this data (error 422): the table does not match the expected columns. Click "Create the table" on an empty table, or rename the columns as expected.
errors.airtable_scopes: The token is missing scopes. At airtable.com/create/tokens, add data.records:read and data.records:write.
errors.airtable_token_format: An Airtable access token starts with "pat". What you pasted is not one (old API key, base ID, or other text).
errors.airtable_base_format: The base ID starts with "app" (for example appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Paste it alone, or paste the base's address: the ID will be extracted.
errors.airtable_tables_missing: Some tables do not exist yet, or the token has no access to them, or the base ID is wrong. Click "Create / update the tables"; if the error persists, check that the token has access to this base.
errors.airtable_schema_scope: The token is not allowed to create or change tables. At airtable.com/create/tokens, add the schema.bases:read and schema.bases:write scopes (in addition to data.records:read and data.records:write), then try again.
errors.airtable_tables_distinct: The three tables must have different names.
errors.airtable_429: Airtable is limiting the number of requests (error 429). Wait about 30 seconds, then try again.
errors.activation_failed: Activation failed. Try again; if it persists, use the sign-in page.
errors.mail_failed: The email could not be sent.
errors.mail_smtp_auth: The SMTP server rejects the username or password. With Gmail you need an "app password" (2-step verification turned on), not the account password.
errors.mail_smtp_connect: Cannot reach the SMTP server. Check SMTP_HOST and SMTP_PORT (Gmail: smtp.gmail.com, port 465).
errors.mail_smtp_refused: The SMTP server refused the message or the recipient.
errors.mail_smtp_config: SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASS are not set in the Vercel variables.

session.add_question: Add a question to this assessment
session.guide_1: Start with the overview together with the organisation: spot the weakest sections.
session.guide_2: Here, each card is a question for which the organisation asks for support. Ask why, what it already tried, what is blocking.
session.guide_3: Write your observations in Notes, what will be put in place in Action, and who takes charge in Owner. Everything saves automatically.
session.guide_4: A question deserves support the organisation did not ask for? Switch to the "All questions" filter and tick "Needs support".
session.guide_5: Finally, open the Support plan: your actions are already there, you only need to choose due dates.

ocat.title: Organisational assessment
ocat.desc: Self-assessment in {n} sections to identify your strengths and priority areas for development.

intro.title: Welcome to the {org} organisational assessment tool
intro.p1: This tool supports you in a self-assessment of your organisational needs. It is a starting point to identify together your strengths and your priority areas for development, so that we can support you better.
intro.p2: The assessment is organised in {n} thematic sections. You can fill them in in any order, in one or several sittings.
intro.p3: For each question, choose the level that best matches the current reality of your organisation:
intro.p4: When you answer 1 or 2, a follow-up question asks whether you would like support from the organisation to help you progress. This helps us identify your needs but does not automatically guarantee support: the decision will be made by mutual agreement.
intro.p5: The honesty of your answers is the condition for support that fits your real needs.

mex.title: Monitoring & evaluation: export to Airtable
mex.intro: Three linked Airtable tables: "Organisations" (each organisation's profile), "Diagnostics" (one row per diagnostic, with section scores and support needs) and "Accompagnement" (one row per need worked on in a session: coach's notes, action, owner and due date).
mex.not_configured: Airtable is not configured: enter the token and the base ID in Administration > Airtable.
mex.setup_hint: Do this once, then after an application update that adds columns. It never deletes anything. The token needs the schema.bases:read and schema.bases:write scopes.
mex.sync_hint: Creates or updates the rows. Sending is also automatic: when an organisation is created and when its profile changes, when a diagnostic is submitted, and when a plan is approved or shared or a session completed.
mex.csv_hint: The CSV files have the same columns as in Airtable, without going through Airtable.
mex.done_sync: Synchronisation complete: {o} organisations, {d} diagnostics and {a} support rows.
mex.done_ok: All three tables are up to date.
mex.intro_simple: Each diagnostic (baseline, midline, endline) becomes a row of the "Scores" table: organisation details, overall score, scores by section, completion, support needs. A section's score only appears once the section is complete.
mex.setup_hint_simple: Do this once (nothing to do if the table already exists). To create the table from the application, the token needs the schema.bases:write scope.

mailv.title: Email sending
mailv.lead: Invitations, sign-in links and organisations' links are sent by email. To reach the inbox (and not the junk folder), the sender must be authenticated: either by a domain of your own (Resend), or by a mailbox account (Gmail over SMTP).
mailv.provider_resend: Resend: suitable, provided the sending domain is verified (SPF, DKIM, DMARC below).
mailv.provider_airtable: Airtable relay: emails leave from Airtable, with a sender that is not authenticated for your domain. This is the most likely cause of emails landing in junk or being blocked. Switch to Resend (docs/EMAIL.md).
mailv.provider_none: No real sending: MAIL_PROVIDER is not set to "resend" or "airtable".
mailv.from_free: free mailbox address: filters reject it. Use an address on your own domain.
mailv.spf_missing: No SPF record found for {domain}. Add the one Resend shows for your domain.
mailv.dkim_missing: No DKIM signature found for {domain}. Add the "resend._domainkey" record shown by Resend.
mailv.dmarc_missing: No DMARC policy found for {domain}. Add at least: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:you@your-domain
mailv.links_text: Links in emails point to {host} (APP_URL variable). They are on your own domain, which helps deliverability.
mailv.reply_to_none: Not set (MAIL_REPLY_TO variable): recommended, so recipients can reply to a real person.
mailv.test_text: Sends a test email to your address. Check where it lands (inbox or junk), ideally on an address at your organisation too.
mailv.provider_smtp: Direct sending over SMTP ({host}:{port}) from {user}, without Airtable. With Gmail, messages are signed by Google (valid SPF, DKIM and DMARC). Limit of about 500 recipients per day with a free Gmail account, 2,000 with Google Workspace.
mailv.provider_smtp_incomplete: SMTP selected, but SMTP_USER or SMTP_PASS is missing from the Vercel variables.
mailv.from_mismatch: Gmail replaces this address with the account's ({user}). Use the same address, or a "Send mail as" alias declared in Gmail.
mailv.invites_ok: The invitations table is in place.
mailv.invites_missing: The invitations table is missing: run the 0010_staff_invites.sql file in Supabase (SQL Editor). Without it the test email works but no invitation can be sent.

qn.search_ph: Search a question or a topic (e.g. "export", "audit")…
qn.no_results: No question mentions "{q}": this topic is not covered in any section.
qn.no_match_section: No question in this section matches the search.
qn.extra_hint: Does not count towards the score
qn.add_here: Add a question at the end of this section
qn.add_note_base: It will be visible to the project's organisations, after the base questions, but counts neither towards the section score nor the overall score.

analytics.export_failed: The Excel export failed. Please try again.
analytics.csv_hint: Download this block as displayed (filters applied)
analytics.empty: No submitted assessment for these filters.
analytics.empty_project: No submitted assessment in this project yet. Tick “Include assessments in progress” once answers have been entered.
analytics.b2_hint: Mean of organisation scores (1 to 3). Click a section to show its questions.
analytics.b3_hint: Gap: share of answers 1 or 2 among answers 1 to 3. Support requested: share of answers 1 or 2 with support requested, among those where the question was asked. Click a row for details.
analytics.b4_hint: The {n} questions with the lowest and highest means. Questions with more than {pct}% N/A are excluded.
analytics.b5_hint: Mean of the organisations in each group. Groups of fewer than {n} organisations are indicative (greyed out). Hover over a cell for the value and count.
analytics.guided_title: Share of guided administration per group.
analytics.guided_hint: The administration mode strongly affects scores: compare groups with care.
analytics.b6_hint: Only organisations present in both compared assessments are included.
analytics.evo_empty: No organisation present in both assessments with these filters.
analytics.q_na: Questions with a high N/A rate
analytics.r_scale: Scale 1, 2, 3. N/A is a missing value, never 0.
analytics.r_scored: Only scored questions count: no additional questions, no free-form sections, no questions added to a single assessment.
analytics.r_section: An organisation's section score = mean of its scored answers in the section.
analytics.r_global: Overall score = mean of its section scores (equal weights). Project-specific sections have their own score but are not part of the overall score (comparability across projects).
analytics.r_stats: Cohort statistics are computed over organisations (mean, median, sample standard deviation of organisation scores).
analytics.r_gap: Gap = share of answers 1 or 2 among answers 1 to 3.
analytics.r_support: Support requested = share of answers 1 or 2 with support requested, among those where the support question was answered.
analytics.r_na: Questions with more than {pct}% N/A: flagged and excluded from the top and bottom lists.
analytics.r_group: Groups of fewer than {n} organisations: indicative, never excluded.
analytics.r_evolution: Change over time: only organisations present in both compared assessments.
analytics.r_completion: Completion = scored questions answered (N/A included) / scored questions.
